cues: Deaminating surplus amino acids makes ammonia, which is very toxic.
Fish, surrounded by water, simply wash it out: they are ammonotelic.
Our liver converts it at once into much less toxic urea, through the ornithine cycle: we are ureotelic.
Birds and reptiles, which must save water, make nearly insoluble uric acid: uricotelic.
